high_level_description: The image depicts a wall-mounted poster in what appears to be a tattoo or piercing studio. The poster features a black-and-white photograph of two individuals engaged in a tattooing process. One person is seated while the other, standing, is holding a tattoo machine and appears to be working on the seated individual's arm. Both individuals have visible tattoos on their arms, which are prominently displayed. The text on the poster reads: "We embrace all humans. We know that every human is different. And as artists, we believe that there's beauty in diversity.
